import sys; sys.path.insert\(0, '.'\)
import pandas as pd, os

COL_SKU=2; COL_PARENTAGE=5; COL_PARENT=6; COL_NAME=8; DATA_START=5

filepath = 'data/category_listings/Category+Listings+Report_03-14-2026.xlsm'
raw = pd.read_excel\(filepath, sheet_name='Template', header=None, dtype=str, engine='openpyxl'\)
data = raw.iloc[DATA_START:].reset_index\(drop=True\)

child_to_parent = {}
sku_to_name = {}
for _, row in data.iterrows\(\):
    ncols = len\(row\)
    sku = str\(row.iloc[COL_SKU]\).strip\(\) if ncols > COL_SKU else ''
    if not sku or sku.lower\(\) in \('nan', ''\): continue
    parentage = str\(row.iloc[COL_PARENTAGE]\).strip\(\).lower\(\) if ncols > COL_PARENTAGE else ''
    parent_sku = str\(row.iloc[COL_PARENT]\).strip\(\) if ncols > COL_PARENT else ''
    name = str\(row.iloc[COL_NAME]\).strip\(\) if ncols > COL_NAME else ''
    if name and name.lower\(\) not in \('nan', ''\): sku_to_name[sku] = name
    if parentage == 'child' and parent_sku and parent_sku.lower\(\) not in \('nan', ''\):
        child_to_parent[sku] = parent_sku

n_parents = len\(set\(child_to_parent.values\(\)\)\)
n_children = len\(child_to_parent\)
print\(f'Parents: {n_parents}, Children: {n_children}'\)
print\('Sample children:', list\(child_to_parent.items\(\)\)[:3]\)
print\('Sample names:', list\(sku_to_name.items\(\)\)[:3]\)
" 2>&1)
